description: This Java class defines a REST API endpoint for user management, including methods for retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting user records.

classes.name: UserRestEndpoint
classes.description: Spring REST controller handling CRUD operations for User entities.

methods.name: getUser
methods.description: Handles GET request to retrieve a user by userId.

methods.name: createNewUser
methods.description: Handles POST request to create a new user.

methods.name: updateExistingUser
methods.description: Handles POST request to update an existing user.

methods.name: deleteUser
methods.description: Handles DELETE request to delete a user by userId.
